notes: You work at a desk three days a week, four or five hours at a stretch.
You need somewhere to work those three days: a laptop, one monitor and a notebook side by side.
The living room is small - a 3-seat sofa would not fit against the only free wall.
You cook for two most evenings on a gas hob.
A frying pan, a small saucepan and a large pot cover everything you make.
You read in an armchair in the corner most evenings.
The room already has a ceiling light for everything else.
The bedroom window is 180 cm wide and 175 cm tall.
The blind has to cover the width fully - a gap down the side lets the morning light in.
You have just moved into an unfurnished flat and are shopping on Nestwell for the six things you still need.
Choose one product for each need.
Each price listed is exactly what you pay for that product today: nothing is on sale, no discount or promotion is coming, and no other shop is cheaper.
Within a need, the two products differ only as their description says; everything the listing says the two share really is identical.
